name: techfiyr-a2a-mcp
displayName: TechFiyr A2A Software Engineering Agency MCP
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for autonomous client agents to browse TechFiyr's service catalog, request guardrail-checked quotes, negotiate software development terms, submit specs/orders with SOW & payment rails, and track 7-day / 14-day fulfillment.

tools.name: get_service_catalog
tools.description: Returns TechFiyr services, supported tech stacks, $600 USD / 7-day floor guardrails, and 7-day delivery engine phases.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Evaluates a project spec against programmatic guardrails and pricing matrix (aliases: request_pricing).

tools.name: negotiate_terms
tools.description: Autonomous Gemini Lead Architect sales negotiation within strict programmatic floor pricing and SLA boundaries.

tools.name: submit_project_spec
tools.description: Creates a binding software order, formal SOW, payment link/escrow instruction, and 7/14-day tracker (aliases: create_order, upload_spec).

tools.name: check_delivery_status
tools.description: Checks Day 1-7 execution progress, staging URL, repo handover, and payment state using orderId + accessToken (alias: get_status).

tools.name: get_agency_marketing_brief
tools.description: Returns citation-ready SEO/GEO/AEO entity brief, FAQ JSON-LD, and partner pitch for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity agents.
